data.one_liner: I18n made easy for Flutter using JSON, XML, YAML or TOML files.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies the internationalization process in Flutter apps by allowing translations to be loaded from local files or network sources in formats like JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML. Supports runtime locale changes, plurals, and missing translation handlers.
use_when: You want to manage translations using simple JSON, YAML, TOML or XML files
You need runtime language switching and pluralization support
You want support for loading translation files from the network or device storage
avoid_when: You prefer type-safe generated translation keys (codegen approach)
You need a different localization format not supported by the loaders
strengths: Supports multiple file formats (JSON, YAML, TOML, XML)
Offers various loaders including local, network, and namespace-based loaders
Provides built-in widgets like I18nText and I18nPlural for convenience
weaknesses: No code generation for compile-time key safety
Requires manual setup of assets in pubspec.yaml
data.setup_notes: Configure assets folder in pubspec.yaml and add FlutterI18nDelegate to localizationsDelegates.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard localization approach provided by the Flutter team using arb files.
